title: Walk relation of bounded length
statement: Let $E$ be a relation on natural numbers and let $n$ be a natural number. Define $\operatorname{WalkLe}(j,c,t)$ recursively: for $j=0$, it means $c=t$; for $j+1$, it means either $c=t$, or there is a natural number $v<n$ such that $E(c,v)$ and $\operatorname{WalkLe}(j,v,t)$.
